# AI Body Master

> AI Body Master is a needle-free meridian wellness service in Malaysia. A therapist applies a gentle device probe to meridian points; it supports your wellbeing and never replaces your medicine or your doctor.

Free health guide with 1852 condition and symptom pages in English, Simplified Chinese and Bahasa Malaysia. Each page says what it is, common signs, causes, when to see a doctor first, and self-care. For education only, not a diagnosis. If you feel unwell, see a doctor first.

## Health guide

- [Health guide in English](https://aitikbeli0103.github.io/ai-body-master/health/en/index.html)
- [Health guide in Chinese](https://aitikbeli0103.github.io/ai-body-master/health/zh/index.html)
- [Health guide in Bahasa Malaysia](https://aitikbeli0103.github.io/ai-body-master/health/ms/index.html)
- [All conditions A-Z](https://aitikbeli0103.github.io/ai-body-master/health/en/all.html)
